decisions.evidence: Morgen visible positions and https://www.morgen.so/schedule-builder; 90.5K is a Semrush estimate for one phrase, not combined demand or guaranteed traffic.
decisions.readerTask: Arrange a weekly pattern with block validation, overlap warnings and a copyable plan; no calendar writes or auto-scheduling.

decisions.limitation: Useful workflow comparison, not a benchmark of every app or a claim of best overall.
Could mean an app, paper planner or a product/device accessory. Volume alone does not justify a new generic article.
Utility intent belongs to the timer, not proof a calendar article answers it. No timer page generated simply for volume.
Do not manufacture pages for brand typos, Cardhop or every spelling; fantastical can also have dictionary intent.
